videos.caption: If you’re looking for a new hobby to pick up then  you should check out Keramo Studio in Brooklyn.  They offer 1.5 hour beginner friendly pottery classes, hand building, workshops, and handmade ceramics for purchase.  📍 Kermao Studio / 49 Bogart Street, Brooklyn, New York City 🏺 Wheel Class $80 🏺 1.5 Hour Class 🏺 Unlimited Clay! 🏺 At the end you can select two pieces to be glazed and trimmed for pick up in several weeks **YES, they suggest you take off your jewelry when doing pottery. YES, I chose to keep my jewelry on 😊** I’m so proud of my pieces! I made a sauce bowl with a spout, a jewelry holder, a bowl and a bubble cup for my new Matcha obsession.  I think this would be really cute for a first date, outing with your friends, birthday or even a solo date.
